title: Rank Tracker
description: Check where a domain ranks for a keyword. Each keyword is searched once per run, through Apify's Google SERP proxy.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords to check. Each row is one keyword, the domain you want to find, a country, and desktop or mobile.

default.keyword: apify google serp proxy cheerio crawler example

prefill.keyword: apify google serp proxy cheerio crawler example

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: The search query to look up.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Hostname to find in the organic results, such as docs.apify.com. www is ignored.

location.title: Location
location.description: Country for the results, such as United States or United Kingdom.

device.title: Device
device.description: Desktop or mobile results. The request uses a matching user agent.

maxPages.title: Pages per keyword
maxPages.description: How many result pages to check for each keyword. A page is about 10 organic results and one SERP request. The check stops early when the domain is found. The default is one page.
